name: Banner settings (default)
description: The shared default settings interface for every banner (chrome-settings@1): how the Settings dialog you reach by right-clicking one is laid out. The top banner and every plugin banner (Banner settings keeps its own dialog for look + behaviour; this interface wraps it). Every app gets its own copy (chrome-banner-<app>) that follows this one until edited; this default is what the dialog uses unless an app picks its copy.
